answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the reef log shows the live set and the tundra audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 219 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 30 aliases alive therefore means 30 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the harbor quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
